# Synopsis: *The Black Queen*
### Book Two of the Earth Reborn Trilogy

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *Earth Reborn Trilogy* (Book 2 of 3)  
**Genre**: Post-Apocalyptic Military Fantasy / Dark Epic  
**Length**: ~113,264 words · Prologue + 20 Chapters + Epilogue  
**Formats Available**: DOCX, Markdown  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> *"Power was a drug, and he felt a rush when dispensing it. The Empress had spent years showing him that the true purpose of the common people was to serve the crown—and in doing so, become the foundation of an invincible empire."*

***

extra.section_header: An empire forged in blue resin-fire. A holy crusade born in blood and iron. And a sleeper whose power could burn them all.
